column1: # Canonical firmware frames, shared by the C++ formatter test and the Python
# parser test so both ends of the wire agree.
# Columns (tab separated, lines starting with '#' ignored):
#   id <TAB> decimals <TAB> temps (comma separated) <TAB> inputs (comma separated) <TAB> expected frame
# The expected frame uses the two literal characters \n for the trailing newline.
# Avoid exact half-way values (22.25 at one decimal): dtostrf rounds half away
# from zero while snprintf rounds half to even, so such a value would differ
# between the AVR and host builds.
